detector_lane.primary: Formalize Li's criterion and extract the finite negative-index consequence of an off-line zero.
detector_lane.critical_residual: Show how an off-line zero's exponentially growing transformed contribution dominates the complete zero sum for some finite n, with all convergence/grouping conventions explicit.

barrier_lane.primary: Search for a positive operator, Gram form, norm-square, or arithmetic quadratic form equal to lambda_n.
barrier_lane.critical_residual: Prove exact equality to lambda_n and positivity without importing RH-equivalent assumptions.

secondary_lane.primary: Use Weil's explicit formula to generate a finite test-function negative witness from an off-line zero.
secondary_lane.critical_residual: Construct the test function with controlled contributions from every other zero and prove the arithmetic side is nonnegative independently.

falsification_lane: Check every proposed trace/operator proof for trace-class and limit-exchange gaps.
Search finite-dimensional analogues for counterexamples to the claimed positivity identity.
Attempt to derive the barrier from assumptions strictly weaker than RH; reject equivalent restatements disguised as operators.
